onboarding.page.pin.title: Keep Palladin one click away
onboarding.page.pin.subtitle: Pin the extension to your browser toolbar so your vault and password generator are always within reach.
onboarding.page.pin.chromium.one: Open the Extensions menu in the browser toolbar.
onboarding.page.pin.chromium.two: Find Palladin.io and select the pin icon.
onboarding.page.pin.chromium.three: Select the Palladin icon whenever you want to open your vault.
onboarding.page.pin.firefox.one: Open the Extensions menu in the browser toolbar.
onboarding.page.pin.firefox.two: Open the menu next to Palladin.io and choose Pin to Toolbar.
onboarding.page.pin.firefox.three: Select the Palladin icon whenever you want to open your vault.
onboarding.page.pin.safari.one: Open Safari Settings and select Extensions.
onboarding.page.pin.safari.two: Enable Palladin.io for the profiles where you want to use it.
onboarding.page.pin.safari.three: Keep the Palladin icon visible in the Safari toolbar.

onboarding.page.import.title: Bring your passwords to Palladin
